messages:
Amy Chen: @lina quick help — Ecostream (seed, EU) asked for an extended eval. They want a 6-week POC + promotional credits. Options on the table: 25k credits + 30% off for 90 days OR customer will do a 3-mo $10k/mo commit in exchange for 35% discount. Need deal-desk + legal okay. Details: expected workload ~200k gen tokens/day + embeddings workload.
Sam Patel: rough cost calc to inform approvals. 200k gen tokens/day -> ~6M gen tokens/mo. At $0.002 per 1k tokens => gen =~ $12,000/mo. embeddings ~100k units/day -> ~3M/mo; at $0.0001/unit => ~$300/mo. So hosted bill ~ $12.3k/mo. 25k credits ~ covers ~2 days of gen or small smoke tests.
Natalie Song: POC notes: they use chat + embedding search. They asked for SSO and EU data residency. No PII per their answers but they want DPA + short runbook. If we keep them on hosted, toggle logging and retention to 30 days. If they push regulated data recommend Private.
Amy Chen: Customer says they are YC S22 and incorporated 2022 — meets our startup kit criteria. They stressed speed: need running POC in 48–72h. I'll ask for company docs.
Lina Ortega: For deal desk: need formal ask with 3 fields: promo_credits_requested, discount_pct, desired_term. Also need verification of startup creds. My guardrails: credits <= $15k — auto approve; credits > $15k need Dir. Discounts up to 25% ok, >25% needs director review. Commits that guarantee MRR > $10k can change discount bands.
Max Rivera: Finance notes: if we approve credits as marketing promo we need SKU and cost center. Also must agree renewal cadence — if they convert within 90 days we can invoice creditback. Approve provisional credits if AE commits to PO for the committed option.
Sam Patel: small calc I put in chat to show trade-off:
```
Option A: 25k credits + 30% for 90d -> one-off promo cost ~25k credits (~$2.5k net cost) + lower renewal uplift risk
Option B: 3-mo $10k/mo commit for 35% -> revenue guarantee $30k, lower promo cost, larger chance of continued usage
```
Amy Chen: Customer prefers Option B but needs time to secure internal PO. As fallback they asked for 25k credits and 30% for 90d. Asking for deal-desk signoff on 25k credits + 30% 90d or approval to accept commit swap with documented PO within 14 days.
Lina Ortega: I can approve 25k credits BUT only 25% discount for 60 days. For 30%/90d or higher credits we need director signoff (cc @Dirya). Please push customer to commit.
LegalBot: Reminder: NDA + DPA required. If any EU personal data is present, must use EU region and include Data Processing Addendum. Standard startup waiver: must be <3yrs and <=$1M ARR. Provide incorporation docs.
Max Rivera: Confirming — finance will treat 25k credits as promotional expense if AE attaches signup docs and a renewal plan. Approve provisional credits on condition AE collects PO if they opt for commit.
Amy Chen: Thanks all. Plan: I will (1) send link to startup proof request, (2) ask customer to sign short NDA + DPA, (3) push for 3-mo commit PO and share here, (4) if PO not received in 10 days we grant 25k credits + 25%/60d per Lina. @Natalie Song can you prepare the POC runbook and SSO checklist?
Natalie Song: On it — will upload runbook + DPA checklist and a minimal config doc for EU-hosted sandbox. Link will be here within 4 hours.
Amy Chen: will update thread with docs and final ask form. thanks :pray:
